title: Epic Knights of the Seven Kingdoms
description: An addon for Epic Knights - Armors Shields and Weapons which adds various armors, sigils, weapons from ASOIAF Universe by George R. R. Martin, including content from Game of Thrones, House of the Dragon and Knight of the Seven Kingdoms.
body:
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_f62a511e-cd96-481d-9034-d938e037c11f.png)

This is a **non-commercial fan project**.  
It was created for **entertainment and educational purposes only**.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_8ef9f22e-b7c3-4bf0-a029-b202c35f9d9a.png)   Welcome to Planetos! **Epic Knights of the Seven Kingdoms** addon serves only one purpose: add as much **ASOIAF** content into Minecraft as possible. As for release, it contains 45 armor pieces tailored together into **14** armor sets, **17** weapons made of _Valyrian Steel_ scattered across the world, **7** armor decoration pieces including __Hand of the King's Sign__, __Aegon the Conqueror's Crown__ made of _Valyrian Steel_, **20** new banner patterns and **16** ingredient items to craft armors and decorations mentioned earlier!

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_0a269cfa-f290-466b-a0eb-9767c92ac697.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_5947c108-d8e2-4978-a55e-fb305c09e8d4.png) As for now, **EKOTSK** contains 19 banner patterns to recreate various sigils of Westerosi Houses. Some of the sigils are shown below:

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_7a47bba6-ef88-42f8-8296-3a53f804d635.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_707894e6-991a-4cf4-8cd1-e4b770f4a2bf.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_1367deb4-d0c5-4792-ade1-097db73b4a55.png)

Left to Right: Lannister Footman armor set, Lannister Lord armor set, Northern armor set, Night's Watch set, Ironborn armor set, Dornish armor set, Gold Cloaks armor set (_House of the Dragon_ era)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_d6982d64-0a84-4dd3-9603-35eee9ec1109.png)

Left to Right: Gold Cloaks armor set (_Knight of the Seven Kingdoms_ era), Gold Cloaks armor set (_Game of Thrones_ era), Kingsguard (_House of the Dragon_), Kingsguard (_Knight of the Seven Kingdoms_), Kingsguard (_Mad King_ era), Kingsguard (_Game of Thrones_), Valyrian Steel Plate Armor set which is scattered across the world.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_973d48cb-32d8-46a8-a4f2-5d9a6881898b.png)

At this point EKOTSK contains 17 famous and renown weapons from ASOIAF universe, some of them being Blackfyre, Dark Sister, Dawn, Ice, Robert Baratheon's War Hammer, and more! Each of the weapons could be found in various structures with really low chance of spawning in a chest. Beware: each of these items is **LIMITED**: __EACH WEAPON IS SPAWNING ONLY ONCE PER SAVE FILE!__.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_861400c2-cfbf-433f-bd2b-4b2bcaf0a450.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_2e179add-7ab9-4ddc-bb0b-4aa5052539ef.png)

When acquired, each of the mentioned weapons grants you an advancement with some lore of the item found.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_275178cf-7a30-4578-85f6-014aec256925.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_614500b0-bef5-4c88-ae01-ea13e0836b33.png)

1.  I highly encourage you to post all the problems, bugs, ideas and thoughts at the GitHub issues provided! I can't promise to respond quickly but I'll react eventually!
2.  Better Combat support is included by default.
3.  "Will there be x.yy.zz version of the mod?" As for now I'm planning to port it to 1.21.1. I WON'T DOWNGRADE mod to earlier versions like 1.19 and below.
4.  Works the best with Vanilla Tweaks [HD Shield Banner Patterns](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/) resourcepack, and other addons for [Epic Knights](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-knights-armor-and-weapons).

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1591388/description_a4731ebf-1762-480b-8192-8e8c3daa41a2.png)

I would like to wholeheartedly thank **Magistu** for being ready to answer every question about his mod's "inners", **P\_Percuk** for designing modpage, **ItzMarine** for making half of the mod's banners and almost every valyrian sword included, **Skydog** for Northern armor set, **Thrundar** for Lannister Footman and Lannister Lord armor sets, and [Westercraft](https://www.westercraft.net/) server administration and awesome community which contributed with banners added to the mod and gave me permission to do some screenshoting on the handpainted map of the Westeros with famous builds.

Stay tuned!
